metadata.description: Loaded in the agent's process. Gates every governed call, evaluates Cedar policies from signed bundles, halts in layers, and records every decision before the action proceeds.
metadata.displayName: White Tower enforcement point for Python
metadata.name: ep-python

bufferPath.description: Location of the durable evidence buffer.

bundleKeys.description: File with the bundle signing keys the enforcement point trusts, its trust root.

coreUrl.description: Base URL of the core's machine listener.

credentials.description: How the enforcement point authenticates as the agent.

arguments.description: What decision events record about tool arguments (contract, section 8.3).

hmacKeyFile.description: File with the key of the hashed mode, which the deployment holds (contract, section 8.3).

hmacKeyId.description: The key's ID, which decision events record as key_id with each HMAC.
